$Comment: The shared skeleton every 'bring down some of these' contract inherits from. A child names its quarry and how many of them, and inherits the step, the match mode and the shape of the pay. Nothing here names a board: that belongs to the child, because the same hunt is routine work on one board and a real ask on another. CONTAINS matching is deliberate - it catches every variant of a creature id rather than one exact spelling.
